concerns.text: The plan computes Variance Inflation Factors (VIF) for the predictors and only flags any VIF > 5, but it does not specify any corrective action (e.g., removing or orthogonalising collinear predictors). Because salience_score, luminance, contrast, and edge_density are all derived from the same stimulus image, they can be substantially correlated, risking biased fixed‑effect estimates for salience. A more rigorous approach (e.g., pre‑model collinearity reduction, regularisation, or hierarchical partitioning) should be described to ensure the predictor of interest is not confounded by these low‑level covariates.
